900.2.10(290).explanation: Exception R 290 covers a few named lots on Roncesvalles Ave. and Grenadier Rd.: a personal service shop is allowed at 74 Roncesvalles Ave. if the rest of the building is one dwelling unit and the by-law is otherwise met, and older by-laws or sections still govern 130 Grenadier Rd., 314 Roncesvalles Ave. and the lands under Section 12(1) 231(b) of By-law 438-86. These site-specific rules are disclosed but not evaluated by us.

900.2.10(900).explanation: Exception R 900 covers named lots in the Annex area: 140 Madison Ave. may hold a nursing, care or retirement home or seniors community house, and older by-laws or sections still govern a list of addresses on Admiral Rd., Brunswick Ave., Dalton Rd., Madison Ave., St. George St., Spadina Rd., Walmer Rd. and Howland Avenue. These site-specific rules are disclosed but not evaluated by us.
